sentences.en: He thought she spoke reasonably, so he accepted her suggestion.
sentences.zh: 他认为她说得有道理，所以接受了她的建议。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get reasonably skilled?
sentences.zh: 要多久才能达到相当熟练的程度？

sentences.en: Can Algeria reasonably aspire to become a wealthy country?
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚能否合理地期望成为一个富裕国家？

senses.zh: 明辨道理地，合理地；有理性地相当地，适度地
